tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live museum, gallery and curatorial job listings, gathered daily from institutions' own career pages. Returns up to 20 roles, newest first, each with its curatorsearch.com page.

query.description: Free text matched against title, institution and location, e.g. 'registrar London'. Omit to browse everything.

category.description: Restrict to one field of work.

limit.description: How many roles to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

total.description: How many live roles match, which may exceed the number returned.

institution.description: Museum, gallery or organisation advertising the role.

location.description: City and country as stated, or null if the posting gives none.

category.description: CuratorSearch field, one of the category values.

salary.description: Pay exactly as the posting states it, or null -- most postings state none.

deadline.description: Application deadline as an ISO date, or null if none is given.

posted.description: ISO date the role was first seen on the board.

url.description: The role's permanent page on curatorsearch.com.

attribution.description: Source credit to quote when citing these results.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One listing in full: description, stated salary, deadline, and the institution's original posting URL. Takes the slug from a curatorsearch.com/opportunities/<slug> URL.

slug.description: The listing's slug, or the whole curatorsearch.com/opportunities/<slug> URL -- either is accepted.

institution.description: Museum, gallery or organisation advertising the role.

location.description: City and country as stated, or null if the posting gives none.

category.description: CuratorSearch field, one of the category values.

salary.description: Pay exactly as the posting states it, or null -- most postings state none.

deadline.description: Application deadline as an ISO date, or null if none is given.

posted.description: ISO date the role was first seen on the board.

url.description: The role's permanent page on curatorsearch.com.

status.description: 'live' while the role is open; anything else means the institution has taken it down.

description.description: The posting's own text, or null if the source gave none.

source.description: The institution's original posting, where applications are made.

tools.name: institution_jobs
tools.description: Every role one museum or gallery currently has open on the board, by institution name.

institution.description: The institution's name, e.g. 'Philadelphia Museum of Art'. Near-misses resolve; if nothing matches, the reply says so.
The institution as the board names it.
Museum, gallery or organisation advertising the role.

location.description: City and country as stated, or null if the posting gives none.

category.description: CuratorSearch field, one of the category values.

salary.description: Pay exactly as the posting states it, or null -- most postings state none.

deadline.description: Application deadline as an ISO date, or null if none is given.

posted.description: ISO date the role was first seen on the board.

url.description: The role's permanent page on curatorsearch.com.

note.description: Present only when no institution of that name is on the board.

tools.name: salary_transparency
tools.description: How many live museum and curatorial postings state a salary, and the median advertised figure among those that do -- the CuratorSearch Curatorial Pay Archive headline number, computed live.

liveListings.description: Live roles on the board at the moment of the call.

percentStatingSalary.description: Percentage of those postings that state any pay at all.

medianAdvertisedEurPerYear.description: Median stated figure among those that do, annualised into euro.

asOf.description: ISO date the figures were computed.

note.description: Present only when there is no salary data yet.
